intent: Refine useful space and photograph presentation while preserving the approved room, category identities and all guide information.
changes: Removed non-functional campus binding clip and hospital screw-like decoration from result bars. Kept restrained material edges, navy headings and yellow airport selected state.
Unified board heading and tab outer radii at 6px; reduced campus edge to 4px and removed hospital toolbar gradient.
Tightened shared reading gap and inset scale, list row padding, fact spacing and summary label/value spacing without reducing font sizes or interactive target sizes.
Category preparation board uses balanced 50/50 title/image tracks; smaller but clear symbols and shorter step gaps preserve full copy with fewer decorative boxes.

Category artwork now uses approved panoramic day/night assets, displayed with their full 4:3 composition and the original illustration caption. These are still explicitly illustrations, not photographs of a named room.

Real directory photos preserve full compositions with natural aspect ratios, height:auto and object-fit:contain. A 420px maximum height bounds tall or square photographs without cropping; wide homepage photos remain naturally shorter. Lazy sizes use auto with conservative fallbacks; sources and full photo credits are unchanged.
Wide real-photo/example cards use equal image and caption tracks. Existing Arabic line-height and logical-direction rules are preserved.
